sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Deal magic damage (Fire) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK buff limit by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK buff limit by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 40% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 160% for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +400

Paira, Heavenly General or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
